records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Your bulk invite question — and a first project
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Following up on your question from last week: teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time, so you won't have to add people one by one. Your ticket on that is closed now, but if anything about the import is still unclear, I'm glad to pick it back up.

On Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — so one real project is usually the clearest starting point before the team arrives.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through your first project with you.

Best,
Priya
